title: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011, Annex II: Substances or products causing allergies or intolerances (consolidated text of 1 January 2018)
publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
reuse: Not read. EUR-Lex publishes the same text, and its own copyright notice sits behind a robot check that could not be passed. The Publications Office, which served this copy, says on its copyright page that its editorial content owned by the EU is under CC BY 4.0, and sends anyone who wants to reuse EUR-Lex content to EUR-Lex's own notice. The consolidated text says of itself that it is a documentation tool with no legal effect, and that the authentic versions are those of the Official Journal.
taken: The 14 entries of Annex II by the names used there, without the Latin names of the nuts, and the exemptions listed under entries 1, 4, 6, 7 and 8, put in our own words. Nothing else.
